method: Direct inspection of immutable artifact bytes against the artifact's own declared AsyncAPI edition and the governing openbindings.asyncapi@1 candidate. Neither SDK's acceptance or rejection is used as the oracle. Every reason code observed in a corpus residual must appear here with exactly one classification (development-loop.md MC1).

classificationPolicy.doctrine-refused: Representing it would require an unwarranted or fidelity-damaging project convention. Permanent by design until that judgment changes. Carries a revisit trigger describing the evidence that would reopen it.
classificationPolicy.upstream-defective: The artifact violates its own declared upstream specification. Not this project's gap; excluded from the supported-artifact denominator.
classificationPolicy.economically-deferred: A faithful widening exists but measured prevalence is below the floor. Records the measured number and the revisit trigger.
classificationPolicy.implementation-debt: NOT a valid terminal classification. Per MC2 an implementation loss can never be laundered by adjudication; entries carrying this classification are open work items and block measured-complete.
classificationPolicy.derivative: Not independently adjudicable; the code is emitted as a consequence of another exclusion and shrinks when that one resolves.

entries.authority: openbindings.asyncapi.md §9.2: the first candidate defines no per-message payload-and-headers envelope; a target whose application contract requires headers at the OpenBindings boundary is an explicit synthesis exclusion.
entries.rationale: Admitting headers would require either an envelope in the operation schema (protocol recompilation, forbidden by ABSTRACTION-FIDELITY.md) or a generic headers member on the invocation frames (explicitly rejected). The exclusion is the faithful outcome.
entries.revisitTrigger: An incorporated AsyncAPI Core or protocol-binding rule that identifies specific header content as application-required value with a defined faithful application-level mapping, such that the value can be projected without exposing a protocol container.

entries.note: Top-ranked widening candidate. The binding-invoker contract's config.value requirement family already names 'a base URL for a document whose only server is the implied /' as negotiable context, so a widening would incorporate existing contract machinery rather than define a new default. Blocked on ruling R1 (OBI-D-13 sufficiency reading).

entries.rationale: Emitted for message and server alternatives whose governing operation target was itself excluded. Never independently adjudicable; recompute after every widening that resolves a parent exclusion.

entries.note: Verify against each artifact's own declared edition. A message $ref that does not resolve in the source is presumptively upstream-defective, but must be distinguished from a resolver gap of ours (cf. finding F2, where deep nested $refs were not resolved before schema copy).

A declared foreign schema LANGUAGE (Avro, Protobuf, embedded OpenAPI Schema Objects) with no faithful JSON Schema 2020-12 conversion. The direction stays invocable through the unconstrained schema, so synthesis reports lossy, never a refusal. Single classification: doctrine-refused. Zero corpus instances after the 2026-08-13 detector correction (the earlier heuristic misclassified application/schema+json as foreign and swept in absent-payload messages); the cell is authority-derived (ASYNC-SS-07) per the anti-overfitting doctrine.
entries.revisitTrigger: A faithful, authority-defined conversion into JSON Schema 2020-12 adopted by a binding-specification revision: for Avro/Protobuf an upstream-defined mapping; for embedded OpenAPI Schema Objects adoption of the project's existing OpenAPI dialect translator (formats/openapi translate.go) as a named conversion — the latter would re-open this entry as economically-deferred pending prevalence measurement.

entries.note: The effective content type has no JSON application-value carriage (application/avro, application/octet-stream, other binary media). Both directions refuse today: input encoding has no codec seam at all, and the decode hook exists but is unreachable behind content-type validation. Synthesis now surfaces this honestly as implementation-unsupported (target when every caller-input alternative is affected, alternative otherwise) rather than lossy-but-invocable. Per MC2 this cannot be adjudicated away: it is open work.
entries.status: OPEN 2026-08-13 (reclassified from doctrine-refused; carriage refusal is a missing codec seam, not a doctrine)
entries.discharge: Extend the ruled hook architecture with a codec extension path (encode seam + reachable decode seam keyed by declared content type), then re-run the corpus; entries convert to represented or, where no artifact-defined JSON correspondence exists for the media, re-adjudicate the residue per-cause.

loadFailureClassifications.note: Artifacts refused before synthesis. Per MC2, only upstream-invalid artifacts may fail loading; every other failure is open implementation work.

A-foreign-schema-format.detail: Avro payload schemas (contentType application/avro; $ref to .avsc) copied verbatim into an OBI 2020-12 schema position. Avro 'type' values such as 'record' and 'long' are not 2020-12 type values.
A-foreign-schema-format.governingRule: openbindings.asyncapi.md §9.2 — a foreign schemaFormat does not authorize copying a non-JSON schema into an OBI JSON Schema position; the operation remains invocable and that direction is represented by an unconstrained JSON Schema unless a faithful conversion exists.

B-dialect-draft07.detail: AsyncAPI 2.x Schema Objects are Draft-07-based. Copied verbatim they carry $schema: draft-07 (OBI-D-06) and draft tuple-form 'items' arrays (OBI-D-17, 2020-12 spells this prefixItems).

C-draft07-plain-name-id.detail: Draft-07 plain-name and pointer-form $id values ('GeneralReply', '#MassCancelResponse', '#/properties/driver') copied into OBI positions, where OBI-D-05 requires an absolute URI. Note: the standalone Go client already carries an isDraft07PlainNameID grammar, so the knowledge exists but is not applied on the copy path.

D-unresolved-nested-ref.detail: Schema $refs pointing into the AsyncAPI document's #/components/schemas were copied without being resolved or rewritten, so they dangle in the OBI (OBI-D-16). Observed at deep nested positions (inside allOf, inside properties chains). Same class as the reply-by-reference defect: reference resolution incomplete at a position the resolver does not traverse. §6 of the binding spec assigns $ref resolution to the artifact processor.

upstreamInvalid.detail: Upstream test fixture authored to be an invalid schema (properties/id/minimum is a boolean). Correctly refused; belongs in the validity ledger, not the supported denominator.

invalidSynthesizedInterface.resolution: 2026-08-13: classes A-D resolved by the dialect translator + position-aware reference traversal + composition alignment (openbindings-go 77048e4/aa19355, openbindings-ts 745f404, asyncapi-client 660b82f/21b0cfb); 17 whole-artifact rejections -> 7. Remaining 7: Elhebert (deliberate invalid fixture), panproto (properties value not a schema), RobinTail (empty prefixItems), specmesh (undeclared Avro = artifact defect under its declared dialect), APIs-guru (properties member named $ref holding a string - investigate), plus 3 cyclic-schema artifacts (ripple, jeffmikels, SENERGY) awaiting $defs hoisting. All still veto siblings pending per-operation refusal narrowing.

maximumCallStackSizeExceeded.detail: TypeScript-only stack overflow where Go completes. Presumptive unguarded recursion on cyclic schemas; OBI-T-11 requires cycle handling without infinite loops for tools that resolve $ref. Distinct from F1/F2 and TS-lane only.
